paragraphs.source_en: Nobuyasu raced his fine horse like the wind, glancing from time to time at the sweat beading upon its neck. Ever since Ayame's unexpected death, Nobuyasu had devoted all his energy to martial training. To be sure, for a time he had also abandoned himself to the fashionable dances of amorous dalliance, but even they could not make him lose himself completely. He always felt that Ayame was gazing at him pitifully every moment of the day.
